districts.name: Old City (Köhne Diz)
districts.note: Hand carts in the lanes; bags out by the gate, not in the street.

districts.name: Bazar-i Kalan
districts.note: Daily evening collection after the bazaar closes. Traders use the yellow containers.

districts.name: Shahr-i Kabud
districts.note: Garden waste on Saturdays in October and November.

districts.name: Soviet Centre
districts.note: Containers in the courtyards of the blocks.

districts.name: Central Square and Liberty Boulevard
districts.note: Daily early collection. Shops leave cardboard flat and tied.

districts.name: Semiz
districts.note: Blocks: courtyard containers. Courtyard houses: bags at the gate by 08:00.

districts.name: Cottonwood Estates
districts.note: Wheeled bins at the kerb. Recycling (blue bin) every other Wednesday.

districts.name: Alatau Heights
districts.note: Collected by the estate's own contractor under licence. Questions to the estate office.

districts.name: Northern District
districts.note: Businesses in the Free Economic Trade Zone need their own contract.

districts.name: Outer districts (east and north-east)
districts.note: Where the truck cannot reach, use the collection point at the end of the paved road.

news.t: Leaf collection in the parks until 20 November
news.x: Leaves from courtyards can be left in bags beside the containers on collection days. Burning leaves in the city is not allowed.
On the agenda: the 2027 city budget (first reading), winter road maintenance and the marshrutka route licences for 2027. The session is open to the public.

news.t: Liberty Boulevard winter lights from 1 December
news.x: The lights will be switched on at 18:00 on 1 December and stay on until the end of the New Year holidays.
Talas Jylu Tarmaktary began heating on 15 October. If your radiators are still cold, call 1-50 with your address.
38 machines are ready for winter. Priority roads: the Trans-Talas Highway, Liberty Boulevard, the hospital and the bus station.
